title: Overview
content: Example Unity Tool is the second demo asset with documentation enabled. Its documentation is intentionally short. It shows that the documentation page adapts automatically: fewer sections, no table of contents, and any mix of text and code blocks you need.

title: Installation
content: Import the package through the Unity Package Manager, or double-click the downloaded .unitypackage file.

title: Quick Start
code:
// Open the tool from Window > Example Tool, or run it from code:
ExampleTool.Run();
